aestheticGoals.outcome: The actual approved model reads as a supported conveyor with a slatted top, two coral rails and visible three-dimensional side/leg structure from the exact accepted goods camera.
visibleChecks: The deck plane and rail depth remain distinct; the model does not look like a flat world sprite or camera-facing image card.
Warm rail shoulders, slate slat shoulders/troughs and beveled honey supports retain the approved native finish. No geometry redesign, terminal collar or additional cap is required or permitted.
Open functional port ends remain those of the approved source; no accidental black patches, exposed raster strips, broken surfaces, clipping or muddy overlaps are introduced by capture.

aestheticGoals.outcome: The approved coral/slate/honey palette remains coherent and readable on the existing cream goods cards at full-canvas 66 and 96 pixel use.
visibleChecks: Deck, rails and supports stay recognizable at both sizes with the current linear-filtering consumer; wood does not collapse to near-black and the deck does not merge into the rail.
Small brass/grain details may simplify naturally, with no sparkling single pixels, noisy edges, blown highlights or arbitrary extra ornament.
The icon leaves the existing label, count text, badge and card margins legible. Assess the actual current card context and actual label/stock treatment, not an enlarged illustration alone.
No per-image contrast, saturation, exposure or extra sRGB grade is added. The newer native materials carry the look; old goods grade is not a styling requirement.

aestheticGoals.outcome: A clean native transparent PNG, without background, halo, dark fringe or imported target pixels, remains clear at source size and after ordinary current-consumer reduction.
visibleChecks: Inspect 384 pixels enlarged and full-canvas 66/96 pixel previews on cream, light, gray and dark backgrounds.
Preserve original render alpha and full canvas; no crop, warp, repaint, recolor, pixel repair, alpha mask or bound fitting.
The exported pixel result must reproduce from the saved editable native source using its exact camera and declared recipe.

immutableTechnicalConstraints.requirement: Exact approved world model geometry, evaluated topology, transforms, native material graphs/assignments, UVs, construction and static root S0 pose. E intrinsic geometry remains +pi/2. The source is SHA256 7a5ce40be2c25adff55b48ddd67370b1ad8598c040ee34768fc55bb48d9b5cf9. No presentation-only geometry, new caps, per-camera recoloring or target-image card.

Use the original 384x384 square-pixel orthographic camera from inputs/camera-contract.json, SHA256 2eaa4ec2899c60a29d9f15b4fd9e44e74d10095ad1a55fd140abc3af3ff7d613: exact world/projection matrices, scale 1.6704699993133545, 35-degree elevation and azimuth, zero shift. Floating transform/projection comparison tolerance 1e-6 is measurement precision only; no per-image fitting or camera adjustment.

Own separate editable UI capture source/recipe and supplement packet. Approved world sources, frames, atlas, packet, review and final renderer remain untouched. The UI-only camera does not replace or change the registered world camera.

No production or Godot modification, no card/layout/control/label/count/badge changes. Preserve the full native canvas and current goods fit/filter behavior. The excluded floor-cream retains its exact accepted source render and atlas crop bytes; the six-item inventory remains six items.

requiredEvidence.requirement: Separate immutable packet binds one actual native RGBA384x384 goods PNG, an editable standalone .blend with dependency closure, camera/settings recipe, native validation and every review preview. Reopening and rendering that exact saved source must reproduce the submitted pixels. Record Blender version, render engine/color management and the absence of added grading.

Independently comparable approved-world versus supplement evaluated geometry/transform/UV/material-node records, root S0/frame1 evidence and exact source hashes. Measure the actual saved goods camera matrix/projection, resolution, pixel aspect and scale. Audit external images/libraries/target-card absence. Verify world source/packet/review hashes and original registered-camera data remain unchanged.

Provide native384 enlarged and full-canvas66/96 use-size evidence on cream, light, gray and dark backgrounds, using current linear filtering/fit. No alpha-bounds crop, altered scale or per-background image variant. Include original goods comparison at consistent full-canvas scale.

Provide actual current cream-card consumer context for the candidate at representative portrait and landscape sizes, retaining the current label/count/badge/layout. Use an isolated temporary preview/harness with current card drawing/fit/filter and unchanged UI assets, without changing production/Godot files. Clearly identify any diagnostic composite; a restyled card mockup alone cannot prove current consumer behavior.

Prove no approved world asset, source, prior sealed packet/review or production/Godot/UI file changed during this supplement. Record the excluded floor-cream accepted source/crop hash parity. Missing native source, exact camera, parity or actual-card evidence yields needs_evidence.

approvalRule: Approve this separate supplemental view only after visible three-quarter readability, source/material/camera parity, clean native alpha, satisfactory 66/96 pixel current-card use and complete hash-bound evidence. A world approval alone does not approve a new camera capture; this supplement approval does not reopen the world candidate or authorize production changes.
